preferred_supervisors.reason: Auto routing uses the smallest reviewed model tier that fits the task and current native catalog. Flagship use is escalation/manual, not the default.

economy.flagship_policy: Use gpt-6-astra automatically only as the next reviewed capability tier when smaller reviewed complex models are unavailable; otherwise require explicit selection or a later evidence-driven escalation path.
economy.retry_policy: Do not loop model retries automatically. Re-plan or ask before repeated expensive escalation.

usage.note: A reported-token checkpoint is a context/usage guard, not a dollar or subscription-billing estimate. Cached input is displayed separately and is not added again to totalTokens.

workers.policy: Spawn only when parallel work is useful; no static roster. Prefer Luna for bounded scans, Terra for normal implementation, Sol for difficult review/architecture/security. Escalate only with evidence.

provider_note: Codex execution is currently verified. Other clients may be detected but need a reviewed official integration and their own authorized login before use. Never extract subscription credentials or put third-party model IDs into Codex's OpenAI-only model selector.

organization.concurrency_note: Maximum three concurrent support workers by policy; the UI must not imply workers are alive unless native runtime evidence says so.
